title: AI Wallpaper Generator
summary: Free AI wallpaper generator: describe an idea and get a phone, desktop or ultrawide wallpaper in minimalist, dark, abstract, anime or pixel art style.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI wallpaper generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every wallpaper on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its standard resolution.


### How do I make my own wallpaper with AI?


Describe the picture you want, its colours and its mood, say where the clock and icons should have calm space, choose a tall shape for a phone or a wide one for a desktop, then generate a few versions and keep the best.


### What aspect ratio is a phone wallpaper?


A phone wallpaper is tall, and 9:16 fits most phones well; the phone crops the edges slightly for its own screen, so keep the subject away from the very top and bottom.


### Can I make a high resolution desktop wallpaper with AI?


Yes. Choose a wide 16:9 shape and set GPT Image 2.6 to 4K before you generate, which costs more credits than the standard size but stays sharp on a large monitor.


### Can I make a live wallpaper with AI?


Yes. Generate the still wallpaper first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model and describe slow, calm motion with a still camera, such as rippling northern lights or drifting clouds, so it loops smoothly.


### Can I make a matching set of wallpapers?


Yes. Pick one style and keep the same colours and subject in every prompt, then make a tall version for the phone and a wide version for the desktop so both screens match.
